Class GameState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.model.state.GameState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
CardPicking, ExtraUpperCardPicking, GameEnding, PlayersFilling, RoundEnding, TotemPlacement
public abstract class GameState extends Object implements Serializable
Base class for the State pattern that drives the game lifecycle. The GameModel delegates every player action (addPlayer(Player), handleTotemPlacement(Player, OfferTile), pickUpCard(Player, Card)) to its current GameState; subclasses override only the action that is legal in their phase and let the others fall through to the default implementations here, which reject the call with InvalidActionException.

Concrete states are PlayersFilling, TotemPlacement, CardPicking, RoundEnding and GameEnding; the discriminator returned by getState() matches one of the State enum values.

  • Method Details

    • getState

      public abstract State getState()
      Returns the discriminator for this state. Used by the view layer and by serialisation to identify the current phase without instanceof checks.
      Returns:
      the State enum value matching this concrete subclass

    • addPlayer

      public void addPlayer(Player p) throws InvalidActionException
      Lobby-only action: registers a new player. The default implementation rejects the call; PlayersFilling overrides it with the actual validation and join logic.
      Parameters:
      p - the player attempting to join
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if joining is not legal in the current phase

    • handleTotemPlacement

      public void handleTotemPlacement(Player p, OfferTile t) throws InvalidActionException
      Totem-placement action: the given player claims the given offer tile. The default implementation rejects the call; TotemPlacement overrides it.
      Parameters:
      p - the player placing the totem
      t - the offer tile being claimed
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if totem placement is not legal in the current phase

    • pickUpCard

      public void pickUpCard(Player p, Card c) throws InvalidActionException
      Card-picking action: the given player picks the given card off the board. The default implementation rejects the call; CardPicking overrides it.
      Parameters:
      p - the player picking the card
      c - the card being picked
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if card picking is not legal in the current phase

    • skipExtraUpperCardPick

      public void skipExtraUpperCardPick(Player p) throws InvalidActionException
      Extra-pick action: the given player declines the optional extra upper-row pick granted by their building, ending the round without taking a card. The default implementation rejects the call; ExtraUpperCardPicking overrides it.
      Parameters:
      p - the player declining the extra pick
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if there is no optional extra pick to skip in the current phase

    • onEntry

      public void onEntry()
      Hook fired by GameModel.setState(GameState) immediately after this state is installed. The base implementation is a no-op; states such as RoundEnding, GameEnding and CardPicking override it to perform their automatic actions or transitions on entry.
